subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` grow a first-class cross-channel account/profile selector for provider-backed models, and what compatibility rules should it use with `/model <model>@<profileId>`, auth order, and existing session state?
rationale: The lower-level auth-profile machinery exists, but choosing how account choices appear, persist, and interact with current typed commands and channel callbacks is product and upgrade policy rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Define shared picker profile contract
options.body: Add one shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channel pickers, including compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

options.title: Keep typed commands only
options.body: Decide that `/model <model>@<profileId>`, `/model status`, and CLI auth-order commands remain the supported account-switching path and close or defer picker UX work.

options.title: Pilot one channel first
options.body: Approve a narrower experiment in one channel while documenting that other channel pickers stay unchanged until the shared contract is accepted.

recommendation.title: Define shared picker profile contract
recommendation.body: Add one shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channel pickers, including compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest sampled history across the shared model override, plugin/channel boundary, and picker-adjacent surfaces.
